Messages.Author: ira...@gmail.com
Messages.Body:
Hello LSJ,

Minion A calls a Political Action, which reaches referendum, and then
passes. Is there a window after the vote ends to play Missing Voice
at mel?

Can it be played during the referendum?

Thanks,
Ira

Name: The Missing Voice
[BL:C2, LoB:C]
Cardtype: Action Modifier
Discipline: Melpominee/Celerity
[cel] Requires a vampire with a capacity greater than 4. Vampires with
a capacity less than 5 get -1 intercept when attempting to block this
action.
[mel] Allies and younger vampires get -1 intercept when attempting to
block this action.
[MEL] +1 stealth.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
ira...@gmail.com wrote:
> Hello LSJ,
>
> Minion A calls a Political Action, which reaches referendum, and then
> passes. Is there a window after the vote ends to play Missing Voice
> at mel?
>
> Can it be played during the referendum?

No. The classic question involves Mask, and the answer is the same: action
modifiers are to be played prior to resolution unless otherwise indicated.
